pages.aboutBody:
{brand} helps devotees book pujas and sevas at temples, yagashalas and ghats in India, in their own language. Priests take the sankalp in the names and gotra you give us, and every booking is followed by a video of your sankalp on WhatsApp.

We work only with venues that let us record the ritual, and we show the venue type on every page, so you always know where your puja is performed.
pages.contactBody: We reply on WhatsApp and by phone, {days}, {start}–{end} IST, in {languages}.
pages.termsBody:
By booking through {brand} you ask us to arrange the puja you selected, at the venue and date shown, with a sankalp in the names you provide.

We confirm a booking only after the payment gateway confirms your payment. The amount shown before you pay is the amount charged.

Rituals are performed according to the venue's tradition. We describe each ritual's traditional purpose; we do not promise any particular outcome.

For cancellations and refunds, see the cancellation policy.
pages.privacyBody:
We collect only what the sankalp needs: names, gotra, nakshatra, your wish, your WhatsApp number, and an address when you order prasad.

We use these details to perform your sankalp, send your updates and proof video, and deliver prasad. Your consent and the version of the notice you saw are recorded.

You can ask us to delete your account at any time. We remove or anonymise your personal data within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep, such as invoices.
pages.refundsBody:
You can cancel free of charge until the booking cutoff, {cutoff} hours before the puja. After that, the sankalp sheet is printed and the booking cannot be cancelled.

You receive a full refund if we cannot perform the puja, if you choose Refund when an event is rescheduled, or if your proof video is not delivered within {refundDays} days after the promised time.

If we cannot ship an add-on, we refund that add-on.

Refunds go back to your original payment method and usually arrive in {expectedDays} working days. For sevas paid in full and cancelled midway, every date whose cutoff has not passed is refunded.
pages.shippingBody:
Prasad is shipped within India only. We ship shelf-stable items such as dry prasad, kumkum, vibhuti, akshata and raksha sutra.

Shipments are booked after the puja is performed. You receive WhatsApp messages when your prasad is shipped, out for delivery and delivered, with a tracking link.

The delivery fee is {fee} and is shown before you pay.
